package validators

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// PHPValidator validates PHP over the canonical HTTP-only transport.
type PHPValidator struct {
	baseURL string
	client  *http.Client
}

func NewPHPValidator(baseURL string) *PHPValidator {
	return &PHPValidator{
		baseURL: baseURL,
		client:  &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second},
	}
}

func (v *PHPValidator) ValidateAll(ctx context.Context, taskID string, files []WorkspaceFile) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(v.baseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("php validator url is empty")
	}

	origin, err := url.Parse(v.baseURL)
	if err != nil || origin == nil || (origin.Scheme != "http" && origin.Scheme != "https") || origin.Hostname() == "" || origin.User != nil || origin.Path != "" || origin.RawPath != "" || origin.RawQuery != "" || origin.ForceQuery || origin.Fragment != "" || strings.Contains(v.baseURL, "#") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("php validator url must be an HTTP(S) origin: scheme://host[:port]")
	}

	var phpPath string
	var phpContent string
	for _, file := range files {
		lower := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(file.Path))
		if strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".php") {
			phpPath = file.Path
			phpContent = file.Content
			break
		}
	}
	if phpContent == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{Valid: false, Errors: []ValidationError{
			{Code: "NO_PHP_FILE", Message: "No PHP file found"},
		}}, nil
	}

	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"code": phpContent,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, v.baseURL+"/api/v1/validate/syntax", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp, err := v.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()

	respBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("php validator error: status=%d body=%s", resp.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(respBody)))
	}

	var decoded struct {
		Ok     bool `json:"ok"`
		Errors []struct {
			Code    string `json:"code"`
			Message string `json:"message"`
			Line    *int   `json:"line,omitempty"`
			Column  *int   `json:"column,omitempty"`
		} `json:"errors"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(respBody, &decoded); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	errors := make([]ValidationError, 0, len(decoded.Errors))
	for _, item := range decoded.Errors {
		line := 0
		column := 0
		if item.Line != nil {
			line = *item.Line
		}
		if item.Column != nil {
			column = *item.Column
		}
		errors = append(errors, ValidationError{
			Code:    item.Code,
			Message: item.Message,
			File:    phpPath,
			Line:    line,
			Column:  column,
		})
	}

	return &ValidationResult{Valid: decoded.Ok, Errors: errors}, nil
}
